prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in League City, Texas, and has neck and back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1259; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not give my name on the recording right now, but I'm happy to answer the questions.

Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where you were when the accident happened?

A: I was driving on a multi-lane road in League City, Texas, heading toward the freeway. I was changing lanes to move into the right lane because traffic was slowing.

Q: What happened as you changed lanes?

A: I checked my mirror and saw a clear space, so I signaled and started to move over. Then I felt a hard bump on my passenger side. The other car had come up alongside me in that lane, and we sideswiped each other. My car spun a little and I had to fight the steering to stop it from going into the median.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before you moved over?

A: I didn't see it in my mirror. I think it was in my blind spot. I looked again but I didn't catch it in time.

Q: Did you stop after the collision?

A: Yes, I pulled onto the shoulder and turned on my hazard lights. The other driver stopped too, and we exchanged information.

Q: How are you feeling now?

A: My neck is stiff and sore, and my lower back aches, especially when I sit for a long time. I felt it the next morning, and I went to get checked out a couple of days later. The doctor said it's a neck and back strain and gave me some exercises and medication.

Q: Have you had any prior injuries to your neck or back?

A: No, nothing that I can remember that was serious.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add?

A: Only that I was trying to drive carefully and I think the other driver was moving faster than they should have been. That's all I have.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
